parse.title: Game Passes
parse.wikitext:
Game passes are Robux purchases from the game's store page. Prices show the standard price, with the Premium member discount where known.

== Confirmed ==
* '''Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED)''' — 1,895 Robux (1,706 with Premium). The only way to become an Original Vampire; also the source of the Natural-Born Vampire.
* '''Sun Ring''' — 695 Robux (626 with Premium). Grants sun immunity plus strength and speed bonuses and unlimited double XP. Unlocks no other powers.
* '''Hide your level and team''' — 395 Robux (356 with Premium). Hides your level and team, for role-play. Type /hide to hide them and /unhide to show them.
* '''Custom Tag''' — 395 Robux (356 with Premium). Puts a custom tag above your name, replacing any other tags. Use /tag followed by the text; for a custom color, type /tag, the RGB code, and the text. Edit with /edittag; remove with /Retag.
* '''Save Progress''' — 495 Robux (446 with Premium). Lets you swap to a different race while keeping your levels and such. Found on the bottom right hand side of the screen.

== Not a Game Pass ==
* '''Original Hybrid''' — Original Hybrid is not bought. It requires level 5,000, a level 3,000+ transforming player, and the Original Vampire gamepass at a 0.5% chance (also stated as 0.1%).
